description: The spec marks the `parentResourcePath` path label required, but a resource with no parent has an empty one: the spec itself says "Use empty string if there is none" on PolicyAssignments_ListForResource, and azure-cli sends '' for it (`parent_resource_path if parent_resource_path else ''` in command_modules/resource/custom.py, used by resources get/delete/update and the lock commands). Mark it optional on every operation of this model that has it, so `parentResourcePath: ""` keeps working.
